name: Baked Feta White Beans with Cherry Tomatoes and Pita

components.name: Baked Feta White Beans

ingredients.name: Cooked canned white beans drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Toss drained white beans, raw tomatoes, onions, garlic, oil and dried herbs in a deep baking dish.
Place the entire block of feta in the centre and drizzle with lemon juice.
Bake 25-30 minutes until tomatoes collapse, beans bubble and feta softens.
Mash a little feta into the hot tomato juices and fold through beans to make a thick sauce.

components.name: Wholewheat Pita
steps: Warm or toast packaged pita just before serving, and portion one pita with each quarter of the bean bake.
Pack pita separately for freezing and do not freeze fresh basil garnish.
